zoe_cs: FYI - PepperCloud submitted INV-PC-2044 asking for a credit after a dedicated failover routed traffic to apac-backup on 2026-05-12. saw a big burst line. can billing take a look? :eyes:
max_billing: pulling metering now. reserved_commit=180k token-hrs, burst_used=81k token-hrs, burst_charge=$15,390 (rate $0.19). spike window ~2026-05-12 00:40-06:10 UTC. ops logs show automated failover due to node preemption.
ops-bot: incident logged: INC-APAC-7450. failover initiated by autoscaler reacting to spot reclamation.
zoe_cs: customer says they couldn't warm; product was hit hard. they want full burst waiver + reversal of late fee.
clara_finance: SLA covers availability credits but not explicit burst waivers. recommend discretionary goodwill credit instead. need AE input on relationship.
mike_ae: PepperCloud is mid-market and growing fast. recommend partial credit to preserve relationship but avoid precedent. propose 30% credit on burst ($4,617).
clara_finance: 30% = $4,617. finance will approve conditional credit pending postmortem and customer acknowledgment that this is a one-time exception. need CS to capture acceptance.
max_billing: will prepare credit memo: CreditMemo:-$4,617 and hold posting until CS confirms and postmortem attached. tag reason_code=GOODWILL_FAILOVER.
ops-bot: reminder: attach infra postmortem and include incident ref INC-APAC-7450 before month close.
zoe_cs: i'll offer 30% credit and request written acknowledgement. postmortem ETA 48h. will update thread with customer reply. :email:
clara_finance: finance approves conditional credit: "Finance approves one-time goodwill credit of $4,617 for PepperCloud (INV-PC-2044) pending postmortem and customer confirmation."
max_billing: noted. will not post credit until confirmation. tagging @ops-bot for ledger tag.
mike_ae: please include a one-paragraph outcome summary for sales ops once closed.
zoe_cs: will do. closing loop after postmortem and customer ack. :white_check_mark:
